ops.title: yasyf box synckit diagnosis v3 (FINAL): serve runs a 0.21.0 image since Jul 19 boot; mise binary was a red herring
ops.body:
Supersedes the "dev synckitd shadow" framing — provenance checks overturned it. The daemon is from the PAST, not the future.

**Root cause**: `com.github.yasyf.synckit.serve` (PID 3425) has executed a **synckitd 0.21.0 image since the Jul 19 boot** (lsof -d txt → /opt/homebrew/Cellar/synckitd/0.21.0/bin/synckitd). Brew upgraded to 0.35.2 on Jul 24 22:11 and relinked the symlink, but launchd KeepAlive only restarts a process that exits — this one never did. Meanwhile `reconcile` (StartInterval 900) spawns FRESH every 15 min and runs 0.35.2. Hence the split symptoms: serve (0.21.0-era) invokes old-name `rpc-serve` → reposync 0.27.3 (rpc-serve-v1 only) answers unknown-command → EOF loop; cc-pool's old-name `rpc-serve` child starts but wire-mismatches the ancient serve. Reconcile's v1-envelope demand and `unknown field "backend"` strict-decode are 0.35.2 speaking.

**Red herring resolved**: the mise-GOBIN synckitd is the SAME v0.35.2 source built locally (go version -m: identical module version + dep hashes; `9999.…-dev` is an ldflags label). All three launchd plists hardcode /opt/homebrew/bin/synckitd with a mise-free PATH — the stray binary only ever affected interactive shells. It was a bare `go install` into GOBIN (which points into mise's dir; mise has no synckitd tool/shim). Hygiene: delete the one file (+ six swarm build artifacts from Jul 23 03:54 beside it); note GOBIN re-creates it on any future `go install`.

**Repair order v3 (yasyf box)**: (1) `launchctl kickstart -k` serve → picks up 0.35.2; observe whether 0.35.2 serve spawns rpc-serve-v1 and/or hits the state-envelope error; (2) brew upgrade synckit/cc-pool/reposync to the A5 baseline releases; (3) regenerate manifests via `reposync install` / `cc-pool sync enable`; (4) `synckitd host add` state migration (preserve peer yasyf@yasyf-home); (5) restart serve/reconcile/cookiesync, watch counters; (6) hygiene: rm stray GOBIN binary, `brew cleanup` old kegs (0.21.0 keg likely still on disk).

**Fleet-wide lesson for the incident record**: brew upgrade + symlink relink does NOT converge a running KeepAlive daemon — a non-exiting process holds its old image indefinitely (serve sat 14 minors stale for months of upgrades). This is precisely daemonkit's "drain on upgrade" domain; synckit's serve daemon predates/lacks it. The A4/A5 wave should confirm the new synckit release adopts daemonkit's upgrade-drain so this class dies.

**A4/A5 gate (recon dispatched)**: verify synckit/cc-pool/reposync MAINS agree on the sync-RPC protocol revision (names AND wire) before cutting releases.
